name: Latvia
englishRequirement: Duolingo 100+ / IELTS 6.0 (UG) | Degree in English OR Duolingo 110+ / IELTS 6.5 (PG)
hookScript: Latvia is one of the most affordable Schengen destinations — only 20-22 lakhs all inclusive. The process can be completed entirely from Sri Lanka. You get Part-Time work rights (20hrs/wk) and a Schengen visa, which means you can travel to Switzerland, Germany, and Italy freely. Intakes are February and September. Shall we book a slot at our Nugegoda office this week to begin your file?

name: Malta
hookScript: Malta is a Schengen island country right next to Italy — incredibly affordable living and a very tourist-friendly environment. With just O/Ls you can enter a Level 5 diploma, and with A/Ls you can go straight to a degree. The age limit goes up to 40, so there's still a great window for you. Special offer: the 2027 February intake has an application fee waiver. Do you have time to come to our office this week?

name: Russia
englishRequirement: Not required — medium of instruction is available in English
hookScript: Russia is the most budget-friendly option we offer — only 10 to 12 lakhs for the entire program. There is almost zero chance of visa rejection and no English test required. Even if you have only sat for your O/Ls, you are eligible. This is ideal if you want to start your international education journey with minimal financial risk. Can we set up a meeting this week?

name: Finland
hookScript: Finland is one of the happiest countries in the world with high visa success rates. Deadlines close soon. Please bring your documents so we can start the entrance exam prep.

name: Lithuania
hookScript: Lithuania has very affordable tuition and living costs. Since your qualifications match, you have a strong chance. Let's start the application tomorrow.

name: Germany
hookScript: Germany offers free or extremely low tuition, but the process takes time. We need to open your blocked account ASAP. Bring your academic records to our office.

name: United Kingdom
englishRequirement: O/L English Credit ('C' or 'B') — no IELTS needed
hookScript: The UK is highly competitive right now. Because you have the O/L English credit, you don't even need IELTS. Let's get your CAS process started tomorrow.

name: Ireland
hookScript: Ireland is the tech hub of Europe with amazing post-study work rights. Since you meet their strict requirements, we should lock in your seat immediately.

name: Cyprus
hookScript: Cyprus is a fantastic entry point into Europe with high acceptance rates. We can do direct admission with an internal test. Can you come in for an initial chat?

name: Malaysia
hookScript: Malaysia offers a world-class education very close to home at a fraction of the cost. The intake is filling up fast. Let's submit your passport copy tomorrow.

name: Dubai (UAE)
englishRequirement: No IELTS mandatory — university sponsor handles visa
hookScript: Dubai has the lowest scrutiny and almost guaranteed visa via university sponsorship. If you are looking for an immediate start, this is it. Let's meet.
